name: Whibbet Massaferrer
original_name: ウィベット マッサフェラー
source:
A tall, exotic, foreign lifeguard who works at the public swimming pool.  She loves to swim and is a cheerful, positive, and energetic young woman. She is as open-minded as the sea and loves to do naughty things.

She has a supermodel figure and a swimsuit with a small area of fabric, and just by being there, she attracts people's attention. 

She has only been living in Japan for about two years and speaks only a few words. She looks very mature, but she is only 21 years old. She is a person like the sun with a lot of energy.

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
